title: The Weight Isn't Yours
core_message: Much of what weighs on us was handed to us: other people's timelines, definitions of success and standards. It feels like ours because we have carried it so long. Setting it down is allowed.
central_insight: Some of what you carry was never yours.
visual_metaphor: A figure stands bent under a heavy graphite stone held against its chest. In one slow movement it lowers the stone to the ground, lets go, and rises to its full height as warm gold light appears. One character, one object, one movement, one payoff.
narration_style: calm, warm, unhurried; a pause before 'Put it down.'

narration.text: Some of what you carry was never yours.
Their timeline. Their idea of enough.
It feels like yours, because you've held it so long.
